tasks.title: Google Maps 5-Star Review with Photo (Bole Medhanialem Branch)
tasks.description: Visit our newly opened Bole Medhanialem Tomoca branch, post a 5-star Google Maps review with a photo of our coffee cup, and upload proof.
guidelines: Include a clear photo of the store or beverage
Mention friendly barista service or fresh roast macchiato
Keep the review live for at least 7 days

tasks.title: Install Kuraz App & Test Search for Addis Ababa Restaurants
tasks.description: Download the Kuraz Food App on Android, search for restaurants in Bole/Kazanchis, and screenshot the search results page showing query latency.
guidelines: Search query must be 'Kazanchis Tibs' or 'Bole Burger'
Device status bar showing Safaricom 4G/5G must be visible
Write 1 sentence notes about app responsiveness

tasks.title: Watch Safaricom M-Pesa SuperApp Intro Video & Subscribe
tasks.description: Watch the Safaricom Ethiopia M-Pesa SuperApp demonstration video on YouTube, subscribe to the channel, and take a screenshot with bell notification enabled.
guidelines: Must be logged in with genuine Google account

tasks.title: Verify Teff Price per Quintal at Local Shola/Merkato Grain Shop
tasks.description: We are compiling real-time grain index prices across Addis Ababa. Take a photo of the price board or ask a merchant for Magna Teff price in your subcity.
guidelines: Specify shop name, sub-city (e.g. Yeka, Kirkos, Bole, Gulele)
Provide current price per quintal in ETB
Upload a clear photo of the store front or price tag
